metadataRaw.title: How to INSTANTLY Improve Knee Circulation and Blood Flow
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly improve blood flow and circulation to the knees.

These exercises are especially good for helping to loosen up stiff knees (due to arthritis) and lessening aches and pains.   

All of the exercises can be done at home, require no special equipment, and may improve circulation within 30 seconds.

Let us know how the exercises work for you!

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
0:37 Knee Scraping
6:27 Modified Knee Raises
8:25 Knee Glides
